summary: Static backend validation for pnpm monorepo (NestJS/Prisma). Ran typecheck, build, and all 17 .cjs regression harnesses. All green. Observability logs (FOLLOWER EXECUTION PAYLOAD + BROKER RESPONSE blocks) confirmed emitted in stdout for ZERODHA, FYERS, UPSTOX, ICICI_DIRECT with all required fields (Correlation ID, Follower Account, Broker, Exchange, Original/Translated Symbol, Quantity, Side, Order Type, Product, Variety, Price, Trigger, Market Protection, Tag, Autoslice, Complete JSON; response block: HTTP/Broker Status, Order IDs, Message, Normalized Category, Retryable, Latency, Raw response). CNC passthrough verified: Zerodha payload contains product='CNC' for CNC master trade. Non-Zerodha broker payloads unchanged (Fyers productType=INTRADAY, Upstox product=I, ICICI product=cash from instrument). No mutation of the sent order or normalized result caused by logging.
critical_code_review_comments: Observability implementation is well-isolated (logFollowerPayload/logBrokerResponse wrapped in try paths; helpers pickField/safeJson/show) and does not mutate the adapter order or normalized result — verified by harness spy equality checks.
product threading is minimal and backward compatible (undefined -> 'MIS' at Zerodha translator only); other broker translators intentionally ignore params.product — good separation.
seed_data_creation: None (static harness validation only, no DB/live brokers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: pnpm monorepo (NOT FastAPI/Mongo). Validation is `corepack pnpm --filter @cts/api typecheck && build`, then `node backend/tests/*.cjs`. Do not start services. All 17 harnesses currently green.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification-only sprint. Product-passthrough root cause (Zerodha translator hard-coded product:'MIS') was fixed in a prior commit; this sprint added permanent observability logs before/after every broker call, verified via harness spies that capture the exact emitted order and confirm no mutation.
